reason: Current tradable is current-state metadata; a stock that is non-tradable today (inactive) may have been tradable in 2018, and an active tradable today may not have existed in 2018. Using current tradable to filter historical eligibility leaks future information.
correct_historical_eligibility: historical scanner inputs available at that time: price, liquidity (median dollar volume), ATR, completeness, spread, exchange/asset_class where known
DO NOT use future inactive status to make trading decision at date T

offline_vs_strategy_distinction.offline_dataset_construction_may_know: Company eventually delists (to define universe offline)
offline_vs_strategy_distinction.strategy_at_date_T_may_NOT_know: It will delist later; eligibility at T should simply include it normally while it exists, then remove only after its historical interval ends

current_implementation.universe: PointInTimeUniverse via build_product_universe, which uses historical bars and scanner (minimum_price, volume, ATR, completeness, spread, exchange) — not current tradable
current_implementation.risk: Current dataset's scanner already uses historical inputs, so tradeability not back-projected
